mentions.name: Pips, but colors
mentions.description: This is a color-based variant of the NYTimes puzzle game Pips. Instead of dominos, players build a stained glass window under regional constraints where colors can mix, and triangle pieces are included. The game engine works, and the tutorial and first handful of puzzles are being designed.
mentions.source_excerpt: Project two started over the weekend and is the NYTimes' Pips, but colors. You're building a stained glass window with regional constraints, and the big difference from using dominos is colors can mix. Also, triangles! The engine works, and I'm designing the tutorial and first handful of puzzles now.
